content: The benchmark methods we test (Section SECREF9) are gradient-based and optimisation-based attacks (Section SECREF2). We propose an alternative model-based method to train a seperate generative model to generate text adversarial examples. Denoting the generative model as $\mathcal {G}$, we train it to generate an adversarial example $X^{\prime }$ given an input example $X$ such that $X^{\prime }$ is similar to $X$ but that it changes the prediction of the target classifier $\mathcal {D}$, i.e. $X^{\prime } \sim X$ and $\mathcal {D}(X^{\prime }) \ne \mathcal {D}(X)$.
